marie (Docs): Quick heads-up — I opened a PR with a tiny migration guide and a Prometheus export example for rate limits/quotas + a Grafana panel snippet. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pull/4321
aj (Eng): Thanks — taking a look. What does the export map to exactly? metric names? labels?
sam (SRE): TL;DR: we need stable metric names and a label for env/customer_id. Otherwise dashboards break during rollout.
marie (Docs): Current draft uses `redwood_rate_limit_remaining` with labels `{env, route, plan}`. Wanted to show token/quota vs. request-count separation. Open to renaming.
aj (Eng): Suggest `redwood_quota_remaining_tokens` and `redwood_req_rate_limit_remaining` — clearer split. Also include `customer_id` label optional.
leo (Product): +1 for clearer naming. Also add note about which plan tiers expose which labels (free vs paid).
marie (Docs): Good call. I'll change metric names. Also added a short JS SDK snippet showing how to read rate-limit headers for clients that can't scrape metrics.
marie (Docs): ```javascript
// minimal example to capture headers and expose to Prometheus exporter
const headers = response.headers;
const remaining = headers.get('x-rw-rate-limit-remaining');
const reset = headers.get('x-rw-rate-limit-reset');
// push to Prometheus client
register.set({route: '/generate', plan: 'team'}, Number(remaining));
```
aj (Eng): That header example looks fine. Please also include guidance to fall back to request-count based metrics if token accounting isn't available.
sam (SRE): For the Grafana panel, use `rate(redwood_quota_consumed_tokens[5m])` and note the panel assumes tokens/sec normalization. I pushed a minimal JSON panel to the PR.
marie (Docs): Nice — I'm linking that panel JSON and adding a short explanation about normalization and bucket sizes.
leo (Product): Small UX ask: add a short blurb on how quota tiers map to billing tiers (example numbers). We shouldn't publish exact prices but high-level units (tokens/hour).
marie (Docs): Will add conservative examples and mark them as illustrative.
aj (Eng): One nit — the Prometheus example should show relabeling to drop `customer_id` in public docs. Sensitive keys shouldn't be in our examples.
marie (Docs): Good catch. I'll redact that and add a note to use KMS/encryption for customer ids in internal playbooks.
deploy-bot: deploy_status: docs preview succeeded for pr/4321 (netlify) :white_check_mark:
marie (Docs): Cool — netlify preview looks good. Final checklist: update metric names, remove customer_id in public snippet, add token vs request fallback note, add panel normalization comment. After that I'll request final review and merge.
aj (Eng): I'll do a quick pass after you push edits.
sam (SRE): I'll sanity-check the panel JSON once metric names are updated.
marie (Docs): Edits done and pushed. Requesting reviews from @aj and @sam. (will merge after signoff) :thumbsup:
aj (Eng): Reviewed and approved.
sam (SRE): LGTM, panel validated.
marie (Docs): Merged. Thanks everyone — will follow up to add a cross-link to the billing tiering guide next week.
